description: This Java class 'CredentialsClientFactoryImpl' implements a factory for creating and managing CredentialsClient instances for the Hono framework, handling connection lifecycle, caching, and event bus communication related to tenant timeouts.

classes.name: CredentialsClientFactoryImpl
classes.description: A factory class to create and manage CredentialsClient instances, handle tenant-specific events, and manage connection lifecycle.

methods.name: CredentialsClientFactoryImpl
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the factory with a HonoConnection and optional cache provider.

methods.name: onDisconnect
methods.description: Clears the internal client cache when disconnecting.

methods.name: getOrCreateCredentialsClient
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves or creates a CredentialsClient for a specified tenant.

methods.name: removeCredentialsClient
methods.description: Removes a specific tenant's CredentialsClient from the cache.

methods.name: handleTenantTimeout
methods.description: Handles tenant timeout events received via message bus, closing the associated CredentialsClient.
